name: Clubbing
overview: Scripture calls believers to remember their Creator early in life and to seek heavenly things above earthly distractions, emphasizing a life centered on Christ (Ecclesiastes 12:1; Colossians 3:1). The love of God demonstrated through Christ’s sacrifice offers eternal life, inviting a response of faith and devotion (John 3:16). Paul’s concern for the spiritual well-being of believers, along with instructions for just and godly relationships, highlights the importance of living with a clear focus on Christ as Master in all areas of life (Colossians 1:1; 2:1; 4:1).
